subject.title: feat(android): add staged Wear status bridge

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this credential-free Wear status bridge as the official first Wear OS surface, even though release wiring and the broader interaction surface remain separate follow-up work?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow and proven, but adding an official native app form factor and deciding whether an unshipped staged module belongs on main require Android product ownership rather than automated code review alone.

options.title: Sponsor the staged bridge
options.body: Accept the status-only phone-owned boundary after current-head checks pass, while requiring an explicit release plan before users are promised distribution.

options.title: Review the stack together
options.body: Keep this PR open until the dependent conversation PR and the complete Wear product boundary can be evaluated as one roadmap decision.

options.title: Decline official Wear support
options.body: Close this PR and the associated Wear follow-on if OpenClaw does not plan to own and distribute a Wear OS application.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged bridge
recommendation.body: Accept the status-only phone-owned boundary after current-head checks pass, while requiring an explicit release plan before users are promised distribution.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository documentation assigns Android app ownership to @obviyus, making them the best available owner for the native-app and release-boundary choice.
